claim: Polynomial-time many-one coNP-hardness of nonnegative legal chip-firing reachability on loopless strongly connected binary-encoded directed multigraphs; together with Hujter–Kiss–Tóthmérész Theorem 12, coNP-completeness of this language.
accepted_reduction: NONHALTING <=_m REACHABLE by an explicit polynomial-time gate/marker construction.
prior_result_credit: Farrell–Levine Corollary 3.2 supplies source NP-completeness; Hujter–Kiss–Tóthmérész Theorem 12 supplies coNP membership. Tóthmérész Theorem 2.3 is a distinct prior polynomial-hierarchy-collapse result.
scope_exclusions: No claim that finite tests constitute a proof.
